headline: Stephen Curry's Warriors Jersey Gets a New Reason After a Record 41
title: Why Stephen Curry's Warriors Jersey Is Still the One to Get
subheadline: His 41 points in an overtime win over Orlando set the NBA record for 40-point games after age 35 and stretched Golden State's win streak to seven.
description: Stephen Curry scored 41 in a 126-119 overtime win over Orlando on Nov. 7, passing LeBron James for 40-point games after 35. Why his No. 30 jersey still leads.
searchIntent: Warriors and NBA fans who saw Curry's 41-point night want to know which record he set and which of his Warriors jerseys to get.
body: Stephen Curry is still writing history at 38. He scored 41 points, with six rebounds and six assists, as the Golden State Warriors beat the Orlando Magic 126-119 in overtime at Chase Center on Nov. 7.
It was his 16th game of 40 or more points since turning 35, the most in NBA history at that age. LeBron James had 15 and Michael Jordan had 12, according to ESPN.
## Why fans are buying in

Curry did his best work late. He scored 17 of his points in the final seven minutes of regulation and overtime, including a runner with 25 seconds left in the fourth quarter that put Golden State ahead. After Orlando forced overtime, he came back in to close it out. It was the 77th 40-point game of his career and his second this season.

The win was Golden State's seventh in a row after an 0-3 start, its longest streak since March 2025. ESPN noted that only the 1950-51 Boston Celtics had followed an 0-3 start with a seven-game winning streak before this team.
The supporting cast is giving fans more to like, too. Rookie Yaxel Lendeborg scored 23 points and hit a key 3-pointer in overtime, and Draymond Green had a season-high 13 assists.

Fans have never needed convincing. Curry ranked No. 1 on the NBA's list of top-selling jerseys for the 2025-26 regular season, based on online sales through the NBA Store and the Fanatics network. In our analysis, a record night during a seven-game run gives longtime fans and new ones another reason to buy in. This is our view, not a sales figure.
## The look

Curry wears No. 30. The banner above shows his royal blue Icon Edition, white Association Edition and black Statement Edition Warriors jerseys. Royal blue is the classic Golden State choice, and black is the bolder pick.
## Why this jersey will last

Curry has spent his whole 18-season career with the Warriors, so his No. 30 never goes out of date. title: Why Lionel Messi's Inter Miami Jersey Is the One to Get Now
subheadline: Messi finished with 26 goals and became the first player in MLS history to win the Golden Boot in back-to-back seasons.
description: Lionel Messi won the 2026 MLS Golden Boot with 26 goals, the first to win it two years running, as Miami took the No. 2 seed. Why his No. 10 leads.
searchIntent: MLS and Inter Miami fans want to know what Messi's second straight Golden Boot means heading into the playoffs and which Messi jersey to get.
body: Lionel Messi has done something no one in MLS had done before. With the regular season over on Nov. 7, he won the 2026 Golden Boot with 26 goals, making him the first player in league history to win it in back-to-back seasons, according to MLSsoccer.com.
He also had 17 assists, and his 43 goal contributions were the most in the league. FC Dallas striker Petar Musa finished second with 22 goals.
## Why fans are buying in

When we wrote about Messi on Oct. 29, the Golden Boot was still a race. Now it is history. He joins Bradley Wright-Phillips, Chris Wondolowski, Jeff Cunningham, Taylor Twellman and Preki as the only players to win the award twice, and none of them did it in consecutive years.

Decision Day was not a quiet one. He set up Luis Suárez's goal with a corner in a 3-3 draw with Charlotte FC, and Inter Miami held on to second place in the Eastern Conference with 60 points. Miami opens the MLS Cup playoffs against the Columbus Crew in a best-of-three first-round series.
Messi, 39, is also the favorite for a third straight MVP award, which no player has ever won, and he is focused on his club after retiring from international play in October.

The demand is on the record. MLS named Messi No. 1 on its list of top-selling jerseys on the MLS online store from Jan. 1 to Oct. 30, 2026. In our analysis, a history-making Golden Boot right before the playoffs gives that lead more staying power.
## The look
Messi wears No. 10. The banner above shows his white 2026 third kit and the black 2026 Presagio kit, in both the replica and the authentic on-field version with patches.

subheadline: Hughes set up the tying goal and won it in overtime as New Jersey came back from two down in the third to beat the Islanders and improve to 12-5-0.
description: Jack Hughes scored his NHL-best third overtime goal as the Devils rallied to beat the Islanders 5-4 on Nov. 7. Why his No. 86 Devils jersey is on the rise.
searchIntent: Devils and hockey fans who saw Hughes win it in overtime want to know how his season is going and which Jack Hughes jersey to get.
body: Jack Hughes keeps winning games after regulation. He scored on a breakaway 1:18 into overtime as the New Jersey Devils beat the New York Islanders 5-4 at UBS Arena on Nov. 7, after trailing by two goals in the third period.
It was his third overtime goal of the season, the most in the NHL, and his brother Luke Hughes made the pass that sent him in alone.
## Why fans are buying in

Hughes drove the comeback, not just the finish. He set up Dougie Hamilton's power-play goal that tied the game 4-4 midway through the third. His 12 career goals after regulation are second in franchise history behind Patrik Elias, who had 16, according to NHL.com.

He is the engine of the Devils' offense. Through 17 games he leads the team with nine goals, 14 assists and 23 points, per ESPN. New Jersey is 12-5-0, has won four straight and has taken 10 of its last 12.
The brothers are part of the appeal. It was the fourth time this season that Jack and Luke both had a point on the same goal, a family story that keeps fans tuning in.

Fans were already on board. Hughes ranked No. 4 on the NHL's list of top-selling jerseys for the 2025-26 regular season, based on sales on Shop.NHL.com and the Fanatics network. In our analysis, a hot start and late-game heroics for a winning team give that support a new reason to grow. This is our view, not a sales figure.
## The look
Hughes wears No. 86. The banner above shows his red Devils home jersey, the white away jersey and the black alternate. Red is the classic Devils choice, and black is the sharpest new look.
